## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behaviour.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. For visual changes, include before/after screenshots with worldline, resolution and scaling. Distinguish source checks, isolated rendering and real guest testing.

## Scope and risk

Mention package/configuration migrations, rollback, licensing and remaining untested behaviour where relevant.

- [ ] New artwork/code has compatible licensing and attribution.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no credentials or private information.
- [ ] Desktop or installer changes were tested in a disposable guest, where applicable.
